business_areas.name: 台北市南京光復商圈
business_areas.description: 位於市區東側，以南京東路與光復北路交會區域為核心。捷運松山新店線提供東西向串聯，連結市區與松山機場，交通條件良好。
business_areas.pp_insight: 位處信義與松山區交界的戰略節點，鄰近雙捷運站點與小巨蛋，具備發展為新興商業區的優越地理條件。然而指標性的京華廣場開發案陷入停滯，為此區的短期發展前景帶來了極大的不確定性。

business_areas.name: 台北市民生敦北商圈
business_areas.description: 位於市區東北側，鄰近松山機場與松山火車站，交通仰賴民生東路與敦化北路等幹道。公共運輸以公車路網為主，捷運可及性有限。
business_areas.pp_insight: 憑藉敦化北路指標性的林蔭門牌，成為金融保險業與大型傳產的總部首選。鄰近松山機場的區位優勢，結合區域內多項重建計劃與都市更新，未來仍值得關注與期待。

business_areas.name: 台北市中山北路商圈
business_areas.description: 沿中山北路展開，南北向交通要道直通市中心與北區，沿線星級飯店與商辦大樓並存，是歷史悠久的商業區域之一。捷運淡水信義線支撐通勤需求，區內道路寬闊，具備市區與外圍銜接功能。
business_areas.pp_insight: 承載著昔日「外交大道」的深厚歷史底蘊，在星級飯店、金融機構與日商企業的交織下，形成獨特商業氛圍。在土地供給飽和下，指標性的危老重建案是其維持區域活力的主要驅動力。

business_areas.name: 台北市信義基隆商圈
business_areas.description: 位於市東南側，以信義計畫區與基隆路走廊為核心，區內聚集眾多國際級飯店與百貨，為台北最具指標性的中央商業區。道路系統完整，銜接東西向快速道路與高速公路，並有多線捷運交會，區位條件優越。
business_areas.pp_insight: 作為台灣不動搖的頂級CBD，憑藉國際金融機構的緊密群聚與指標性建築的門戶效應，持續為跨國企業總部定義市場標竿。頂級ESG綠建築更在此建立新的價值典範。

business_areas.name: 台北市台北車站商圈
business_areas.description: 位於市中心重要的交通樞紐，為台鐵、高鐵及多線捷運匯集地，並結合國道客運轉運功能，台北市最重要的交通樞紐。交通可及性最高，周邊道路網密集，為全市核心區域。
business_areas.pp_insight: 以其「六鐵共構」的國家門戶之姿，極具交通樞紐優勢。儘管現階段面臨舊城區的轉型陣痛，但眾所矚目的雙子星開發案與其他西區門戶計畫正為其注入強大動能，西區未來精彩可期。

business_areas.name: 台北市松江南京商圈
business_areas.description: 位於市中心東側，是台北市著名金融商圈重鎮，曾擁有「台北華爾街」之譽。區內捷運松江南京站為雙線交會，交通路網完整，東西向與南北向動線均衡，往來便捷。
business_areas.pp_insight: 以其雙捷運線交會的絕對交通優勢，屬台北核心樞紐地位。松江南京商圈是傳統金融證券業與日商企業的密集據點，透過活躍的重建計劃與都市更新，正逐步為這個成熟的商業生態系注入新動能。

business_areas.name: 台北市敦化南路商圈
business_areas.description: 位於大安區核心地帶，以敦化南路為主要軸線展開，兼具商業氛圍與高端住宅環境。區內由捷運文湖線及淡水信義線串聯全市，街廓整齊，屬市中心重要走廊地帶。
business_areas.pp_insight: 以其經典的林蔭大道景觀，形塑出獨樹一幟的精品辦公聚落。儘管普遍屋齡偏高，但供給稀缺性使其價值穩固，未來的發展潛力仰賴都市更新的成功與否。

meta.source: FUNRAISE MCP (Funraise Data Team) snapshot 2026-09-14 + expanded pulls
meta.purpose: Compact demo dataset for a Taipei God's Eye View real-estate map prototype
meta.coverage: Primarily Taipei City districts: 信義區, 大安區, 中山區, 松山區, 內湖區, 南港區 (plus a few 萬華區/新北市 reference rows)

units_notes.total_floor_area: square meters (m²) — verified by summing per-floor `area` values against `total_floor_area` on a sample building; NOT 坪
units_notes.actual price/rent unit_price in building: NTD per 坪 per month (rent) or NTD per 坪 (sale), as returned by the API's own comparison/trend endpoints
units_notes.sample_transactions.rentals unit_rent_nt: computed here as monthly_rent_ntd / area_sqm (NTD per m² per month) — a DIFFERENT unit basis than the 坪-based figures above; do not compare directly without converting (1 坪 = 3.305785 m²)
units_notes.mops land_area_ping / building_area_ping: 坪 (ping), as returned by the API

geo_precision_legend.exact: coordinates returned directly by the API for this specific entity (get_building/get_mrt_station/get_public_infra location, or a get_urban_renewal geom polygon)
geo_precision_legend.address: coordinates would need geocoding via land-info.coordinates_by_address (NOT performed for building_licenses/mops in this dataset — see adaptation note)
geo_precision_legend.area_centroid: coordinates estimated from the centroid of a related business_area/district (used only where noted)

adaptations_and_gaps: buildings.search_buildings list view has no lat/lon; buildings.get_building DOES return exact location, so every building here was fetched individually via get_building (this is what consumed most of the MCP-call budget) rather than falling back to address geocoding.

mrt_stations: only 5 of the ~25 requested key stations were fetched (each requires its own get_mrt_station call, 1 per station, no bulk-coordinate endpoint exists) — trimmed to fit the ~75-call budget after buildings consumed more calls than planned.

public_infras: only the first sample item (臺北市立圖書館新總館與臺北音樂廳) has exact coordinates, fetched once during the initial capability check; the other 24 items are listed without lat/lon since each would need its own get_public_infra call and that was not affordable within budget.

building_licenses and mops: NOT geocoded (land-info.coordinates_by_address was not called) — raw addresses are kept as text (first_address / building_address fields) so they can be geocoded later if needed; this was a deliberate trade-off to stay near the ~75 call budget after buildings/mrt/tenants/urban_renewal/future_dev usage.

future_dev projects have no location field from the API at all; per instructions this would need a get_building(name=...) location check, which was also skipped for budget reasons — future_dev entries in this dataset carry NO lat/lon (not even area_centroid), only district/business_area text.

actual-price-sale.search_actual_sales for 信義路五段7號 (Taipei 101) returned 0 rows (no individually-sold high-rise office condo units on record for that address); the fallback addresses (松高路1號 / 松仁路100號) suggested in the brief were NOT tried, to avoid exceeding the call budget. Rentals for the same address returned 56 rows (8 sampled).
zoning_at_point returned no match for 2 of 5 requested points (大安森林公園東側, 中山北路二段); the 內湖科技園區 point landed on adjacent school-use land (zone PS) rather than the tech park's industrial zone.

industrial-parks.aggregate_industrial_parks was skipped entirely: search already returned the full universe (1 park in 台北市, 6 in 新北市, both under the requested limits), so an aggregate call would have added nothing.
meta.mcp_call_budget_target: ~75 (finished ~4% over, after trimming per-item coordinate lookups for public_infras/mrt/licenses/mops to compensate for buildings needing 1 get_building call per row)
notes: licenses/mops/moves: address geocode; road-only addresses approximate
